summary_en: This study compares RO7771950 with tucatinib, each given together with trastuzumab and capecitabine, in people with HER2-positive breast cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic. RO7771950 is taken by mouth twice a day at one of two doses, and tucatinib is also taken by mouth twice a day. Trastuzumab is given by IV or under the skin as local prescribing information directs, capecitabine is taken by mouth twice a day, and how long treatment lasts is not stated. This is a phase 2/3 study that aims to assess efficacy and safety, and the main outcome measure is not stated.
summary_es: Este estudio compara RO7771950 con tucatinib, cada uno administrado junto con trastuzumab y capecitabina, en personas con cáncer de mama HER2 positivo que es localmente avanzado o metastásico. RO7771950 se toma por vía oral dos veces al día en una de dos dosis, y tucatinib también se toma por vía oral dos veces al día. El trastuzumab se administra por vía intravenosa o debajo de la piel según la información de prescripción local, la capecitabina se toma por vía oral dos veces al día, y no se indica cuánto dura el tratamiento. Este es un estudio de fase 2/3 que busca evaluar la eficacia y la seguridad, y la medida de resultado principal no se indica.
who_for: Locally advanced, inoperable or metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer confirmed by central lab.
At least one prior line of anti-HER2 therapy for advanced disease.
Brain or leptomeningeal metastases allowed, whether previously treated or untreated.
Baseline left ventricular ejection fraction of 50% or higher.
not_for: Anti-cancer or investigational treatment within 28 days before starting study treatment.
Prior tyrosine kinase inhibitor treatment for advanced or metastatic disease.
Active untreated hepatitis B or C, or chronic liver disease.
Significant heart disease, including heart failure with NYHA class II or higher.
Concomitant strong CYP3A4 or CYP2C8 inhibitors or inducers, or oral coumarin-derivative anticoagulants.
